School & learning

part of speech noun

also parts of speech, what part of speech is it?, how many parts of speech are there?, word class

classical

Quint. 1.4.19: noster sermō articulōs nōn dēsīderat, ideōque in aliās partēs ōrātiōnis sparguntur
Quint. 1.5.48: fīunt soloecismī et quidem plūrimī per partēs ōrātiōnis
Traupman 220, 238, 248

pars ōrātiōnis, partis ōrātiōnis f.

noun phrase: pars, third declension, with the genitive ōrātiōnis

a part of speech: noun, verb, adverb and the rest

Literally “a part of speech”: ōrātiō is speech, language, and its parts are the kinds of word. Quintilian (1.4.18–20) tells how the ancients counted first three (verba, nōmina, convinctiōnēs) and later eight. The teacher’s question is Quae pars ōrātiōnis est?, what part of speech is it?

Examples

  • fīunt soloecismī et quidem plūrimī per partēs ōrātiōnis

    mistakes of grammar happen, and very many of them, through the parts of speechQuint. 1.5.48

  • Partēs ōrātiōnis quot sunt?

    How many parts of speech are there?Traupman 220

  • «Arma» quae pars ōrātiōnis est?

    What part of speech is “arma”?Traupman 239

See also noun, verb, adjective, pronoun, adverb, conjunction, preposition, interjection, participle, grammar.
